core_obligations: Parts (5), (3), (1) (proof lines 21294-21299): represent M by a K-injective complex of abelian sheaves and apply the comparison of injectives, working out the definitions; part (3) follows since i_f^{-1}pi_S^{-1} = f_small^{-1}, and part (1) is a special case of (3).

Parts (6), (4), (2) (proof lines 21301-21305): part (6) follows from the general cohomology comparison for a continuous cocontinuous functor; part (4) follows because Lf_small^* = i_f^* composed with Lpi_S^*, and part (2) is a special case of (4).
proof_roadmap: Handle the abelian cases through K-injective representatives and the injectivity comparison, using the identity i_f^{-1}pi_S^{-1} = f_small^{-1}.
Handle the module cases through the general cocontinuous comparison and the factorisation of Lf_small^*.
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects six identifications between cohomology computed on the big etale site over S and on the small etale sites of S and T (statement lines 21274-21291). The proof (proof lines 21293-21305) uses K-injective representatives and the injectivity comparison for the abelian cases, with the identity i_f^{-1}pi_S^{-1} = f_small^{-1}, and the general cocontinuous comparison together with the factorisation of Lf_small^* for the module cases. H2: two short reductions covering six statements, written out.
